title: Pulse Waveform Library
text: Library of pulse waveforms, 1 input, 1 output; {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of the output, {Specification of each waveform in the library} sets the pulse waveforms in the library, {Source of simulation sample time} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Pulse waveform samples complex-valued column vector | complex-valued matrix

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of the output waveform 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Specification of each waveform in the library
params.values: Pulse waveforms in the library {{’Rectangular’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6},{’LinearFM’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6,’SweepBandwidth’,1e5,’SweepDirection’,’Up’,’SweepInterval’,’Positive’}} (default) | cell array

params.name: Source of simulation sample time
params.values: Source of simulation sample time Derive from waveform parameters (default) | Inherit from Simulink engine

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
